title: Deployment Request
description: Input contract for creating or updating a persistent deployment via the deployment-manager. Consumed from nosana-deployment-architect's deployment-plan.schema.json (deployment_strategy block).

operation.description: The deployment lifecycle operation to perform

deployment_id.description: Required for update-revision, scale, stop, start, fund-vault. Null for create.

name.description: Human-readable deployment name. Required for create.

strategy.description: Deployment lifecycle strategy. INFINITE = always-on rotation. SCHEDULED = cron. SIMPLE = one-shot via deployment-manager. SIMPLE-EXTEND = one-shot with extension.

market.description: Market slug or Solana PublicKey address

timeout_seconds.description: Per-job timeout in seconds. Rotation fires at timeout - rotation_offset_seconds.

rotation_offset_seconds.description: How many seconds before timeout to post the replacement job (INFINITE only).

replicas.description: Number of concurrent running job instances (INFINITE only).

schedule.description: Cron expression for SCHEDULED strategy. Example: '0 */6 * * *' (every 6 hours).

job_definition.description: Full Nosana job definition object. Must be a valid job definition conforming to nosana-deployment-architect output.

confidential.description: Whether to deploy using confidential mode (encrypted job definition).

deployment_manager_url.description: Base URL of the deployment-manager REST API. Must be set in environment as DEPLOYMENT_MANAGER_URL.
